title: Onboarding Team Workload Capacity
content: Agent capacity calculations for single-unit and multi-unit properties. Single Unit: ~4.5 hrs each. Multi-Unit (3 categories 9 units): ~14.5 hrs each. Listing Update: ~0.75 hrs each. Monthly capacity per agent: 25-30 single units or 8-10 multi-units or 150-170 updates.

title: New Onboarding Tracker — How It Works

title: Onboarding Accuracy Checklist — Property Audit
content: 26-question audit checklist. Sections: 1) Property Details 2) Photos and Media 3) Description and Amenities 4) Rates and Availability 5) Integration and Channel Settings 6) Operational Details 7) Final Review. Scoring: Accuracy % = (Correct Answers divided by 26) x 100.

title: PriceLabs — Overview & Navigation
content: Overview of the PriceLabs dashboard and the areas the onboarding team regularly accesses. Used to manage dynamic pricing rules and sync rates across listings. Key sections: Dashboard, Listings, Pricing Settings, Sync Status.

title: Raising a Support Ticket with Rentals United
content: How to raise a support ticket with Rentals United. Step 1: Go to left-hand corner menu and select Get Support. Step 2: Fill in Email Notifications with relevant addresses. Step 3: Include specific property names, IDs, screenshots and exact error messages. Step 4: Submit the form and note the ticket number. Step 5: Track ticket status from the tickets page.
